verses.text: Then Job answered:
"How long will you keep hurting me and crushing me with your words?
Ten times now you have insulted me. You attack me without any shame.
Even if it is true that I have done wrong, my mistake is my own business.
If you really want to make yourselves look better than me and use my shame as proof against me,
then know that God has wronged me and caught me in his net.
I cry out, 'Help! I am being treated wrongly!' But I get no answer. I call for help, but there is no justice.
God has blocked my way so I cannot get through. He has covered my paths with darkness.
He has taken away my honor and removed the crown from my head.
He tears me down on every side until I am gone. He has pulled up my hope like a tree.
His anger burns against me. He thinks of me as one of his enemies.
His armies come together. They build ramps to attack me and camp around my tent.
He has driven my brothers far away from me. The people who knew me have turned away.
My relatives have gone away, and my close friends have forgotten me.
My guests and my servant girls treat me like a stranger. They look at me as if I were a foreigner.
I call my servant, but he does not answer, even when I beg him.
My breath disgusts my wife. My own brothers find me disgusting.
Even little children look down on me. When I get up, they make fun of me.
All my closest friends hate me. Those I love have turned against me.
I am nothing but skin and bones. I have escaped with only the skin of my teeth.
Have pity on me, my friends! Have pity on me, because God's hand has struck me.
Why do you chase me as God does? Haven't you hurt my body enough?
I wish my words were written down! I wish they were written in a book!
I wish they were carved in rock forever with an iron tool and filled with lead!
But I know that the one who will rescue me is alive. In the end, he will stand on the earth.
Even after my skin has been destroyed, I will see God with my own body.
I myself will see him on my side. I will see him with my own eyes, not as a stranger. How my heart longs for that day!
If you say, 'Let's keep after him, since the root of the trouble is in him,'
then you should be afraid of the sword yourselves. God's anger brings punishment by the sword, so that you will know there is a judgment."
